title: Proposed next-wave specimen and bridge-aliquot ledger
description: Planning template only, not a validated laboratory SOP. No participant records are supplied. Use coded participant keys, not names. The study team must define acceptance criteria, access controls, processing requirements and assay validation. Missing data stay null with an explanation rather than being filled with a guessed value.

participant_key.description: Study-coded key; null for shared nonparticipant controls.

specimen_type.description: Explicit source and preparation, e.g. whole-blood cell fraction, isolated PBMC, extracted DNA. These are not interchangeable.

viable_cell_count.description: Measured count with separate documented counting method; not inferred from T/S.

parent_specimen_id.description: Allows distinction between aliquot repeats and independent preparations.

transfer_temperature_record.description: Reference to a measured log; no assumed temperature or acceptance threshold.

randomization_block.description: Prospective allocation record; do not infer randomization retrospectively.

outcome_value_and_units.description: Specify the assay and units. Do not mix telomere T/S, telomerase activity, cell count or flow measurements.

deviations_or_missingness.description: Include unresolved timestamps, negative calculated duration, temperature excursions and reasons for missing data.
